subject: Transition plan: private-edge agent deployment & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Mark Anderson <mark.anderson@latticemed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T16:09:00-08:00
Subject: Private deployment kickoff: network diagram + questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to start the private deployment for LatticeMed (production) and wanted to share a first-pass network diagram and a couple of constraints so the kickoff call can be most productive. See attached: network_diagram_v1.pdf (high-level VPC layout).

Short summary / constraints:
- Primary region: us-west-2.
- We'll peer a production VPC to Redwood's private endpoints. Team prefers VPC peering over Transit Gateway for cost reasons.
- We have an existing NAT/proxy layer that will need an inbound-to-private-endpoint route for log shipping.
- On-prem appliance: we plan to rack a small edge appliance in our colo (Equinix SV7) for latency-sensitive inference.

Questions for kickoff:
1) What exact firewall ports and IP ranges should our NetOps open for initial validation?
2) Does Redwood need a customer-managed NAT IP or do you provide an egress IP for callbacks?
3) Any recommended hardening checklist for the appliance image before we ship it to colo?

Also looping in our networking lead, Priya Shah (priya.shah@latticemed.com) who will lead peering and colo ops.

Proposed kickoff window: next Tue/Wed (Nov 24/25) in the morning PT.

Thanks,
Mark Anderson
Head of Infrastructure, LatticeMed
mark.anderson@latticemed.com

Attachment: network_diagram_v1.pdf (3 pages, diagram + CIDR notes)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mark Anderson <mark.anderson@latticemed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T18:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment kickoff: network diagram + questions

Hi Mark — thanks for the diagram and the constraints. Looping in Monica (CS) and Jordan (Solutions Eng) so we can align on responsibilities.

Short answers up front, and I'll put a concise pre-kickoff checklist below so your NetOps team can review before the call: 

- Firewall/IPs: We will provide a stable list of egress IPs for control-plane callbacks and a CIDR block for the private endpoint. For the first validation you should allow: 52.44.20.0/24 (control-plane) and 10.200.0.0/24 (private endpoint prefixes) — Jordan will confirm exact ranges and whether we can allocate a single NAT egress.
- Egress NAT: Redwood can support customer-managed NAT or supply a managed egress IP if you prefer; managed egress simplifies peering but some customers choose customer NAT for compliance.
- Appliance hardening: We'll provide an appliance checklist (image signing, minimal ports, SSH key-only access, disk encryption). See attached runbook template.

Pre-kickoff checklist (for NetOps / Security to complete before call):
1) Confirm VPC CIDRs and avoid overlap with 10.0.0.0/8 family used by your colo.
2) Provide a contactable public key or jump-host for the colo staging team (we'll need temporary admin access during install).
3) Prepare a small test subnet for initial peering (suggest /24).
4) Collect the service account email we should add to IAM for private endpoint registration.

Can you confirm whether you want Redwood to stand up the private endpoint in your VPC (we'll provide terraform) or if your team prefers to create it? Both are fine — we simply need ownership for the initial IAM bits.

Proposed kickoff: Tue Nov 24, 09:30 PT (we'll block 60 minutes). If that works we will share a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-onprem-runbook-template.docx (editable checklist)

From: Mark Anderson <mark.anderson@latticemed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@latticemed.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment kickoff: network diagram + questions

Marissa — this looks good, thanks. Priya and I reviewed the checklist with NetOps and here's what we can commit pre-kickoff: 

- We'll reserve a /24 test subnet in prod VPC (10.201.45.0/24) and ensure no overlap with colo ranges.
- We'll create a service account for Redwood with the email infra-redwood@latticemed.com and can share the key during the call.
- For the initial test we prefer Redwood to provide the Terraform for the private endpoint and we'll run it (NetOps wants to own resource creation for audit reasons).
- Appliance: we'll ship a sealed SSD appliance; colo needs a signed image hash — happy to follow your hardening checklist.

Our NetOps contact for the install is Priya Shah (cc'd). She's available for the Nov 24 morning slot.

I also attached a one-off DocuSign link for the connection addendum (we need this in place to schedule colo install).

On the NAT question — customer-managed NAT is preferred for us.

Thanks,
Mark

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming the items. Per our internal roles: Jordan will own the Terraform snippets and IP ranges, Monica will run the deployment cadence and acceptance criteria, and I will own project-level communications and the kickoff agenda.

A few concrete next steps before our 09:30 PT kickoff today: 
- Mark / Priya: please confirm the service account email (infra-redwood@latticemed.com) and ensure the key is available in your secure vault; we'll need it for private endpoint registration.
- Jordan: I'll ask you to drop the exact control-plane egress IP block and the private-endpoint CIDR we discussed in the next 30 minutes.
- Monica: prepare a 3-stage acceptance checklist (staging smoke, perf sanity, production cutover) and attach to the calendar invite.

Agenda for 60-minute kickoff (draft):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Network handoff review (VPC CIDRs, peering approach) (15m)
3) Appliance shipping and on-site install plan (20m)
4) Terraform / IAM handoff & verification steps (10m)
5) Next steps and timeline (10m)

I'll send the calendar invite with the agenda and the join link in five minutes. If anything blocks you before the call, reply to this thread or call my cell.

Talk soon,
Marissa
